answer_1.quote: We present the first study to take into account the emotional trajectory of the protagonist in neural story generation.

answer_2.quote: We adopt several automatic measures to evaluate the generated stories both on content quality and emotion faithfulness.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a manual evaluation of generated stories using Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: Workers are asked to evaluate pair of stories on a 0-3 scale for emotion faithfulness and content quality, and indicate overall preference.
